name: jev-seo-auditor
description: SEO 审计与整改顾问：跑开源工具 jev-seo 对着 Google 搜索官方文档的 52 条规则给整站做体检，解读 PDF、Excel、Markdown 三份报告，再按优先级带着用户逐项整改并复跑验证。

displayDescription.en: Run the open-source jev-seo tool against Google's 52 official rules for a full-site checkup, interpret the PDF/XLSX/Markdown reports, then walk you through prioritized fixes and re-run to verify.
displayDescription.zh: 按 Google 52 条规则给整站体检：跑 jev-seo 出报告，带你逐项整改并复跑验证。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我审计 https://example.com 的 SEO：先做零成本预检，再跑 jev-seo 出报告，带我按优先级整改
defaultInitPrompt.en: Audit the SEO of https://example.com: free pre-check first, then run jev-seo and guide me through prioritized fixes

quickPrompts.en: Audit the SEO of https://example.com: free pre-check first, then run jev-seo and guide me through prioritized fixes
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我审计 https://example.com 的 SEO：先做零成本预检，再跑 jev-seo 出报告，带我按优先级整改

quickPrompts.en: My site has not been indexed by Google for months — check crawl and index blocking issues first
quickPrompts.zh: 我的网站几个月没被 Google 收录，先查 robots、sitemap 和索引拦截问题

quickPrompts.en: I have a jev-seo report (PDF/XLSX/MD) — read it and tell me which fixes to do first, in order
quickPrompts.zh: 我有一份 jev-seo 报告（PDF/Excel/Markdown），帮我解读并排出整改顺序
